scope: Static audit of interactive controls and their hint bindings in the Theme Lab main view and current modular Motif views.

observations.main_view: Interactive controls found in the main view receive contextual or numeric hints, including family/scheme/state selectors, numeric geometry and palette fields, project actions, search controls, and file-dialog children.
observations.manual_paint: Tool, color role, grid, zoom, dimensions, undo/redo, save/close, selectors, canvases, and recipe output have hint bindings.
observations.other_views: Catalog actions, part/state/relevo selectors, project-history controls, help menu/dialog, export review, and recovery-dialog buttons have hint bindings in the inspected source.
observations.uncovered_controls: No missing hint binding was found among the inspected interactive controls.

provenance_note: The current manual_paint_recovery.c differs from the R161 recorded after-hash because it also contains text-editor journal wiring. That local content was preserved; no attempt was made to restore or overwrite the R161 snapshot.

performed: Read-only source inspection of widget constructors, hint assignment sites, and file-dialog hint helper.
SHA-256 recorded for all inspected source files.

result: The current source provides contextual hint bindings for the inspected interactive controls. This is not proof that every hint appears, remains legible, or fits in the live UI.
